paragraphs.label: Mở thư và mục đích
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to invite you to a student employment workshop. We would be pleased to welcome you and believe that your participation would be valuable. The event will focus on part-time jobs for students.

I am writing to invite you to [sự kiện / hoạt động]. We would be pleased to welcome you and believe that your participation would be valuable. The event will focus on [chủ đề].

paragraphs.label: Sắp xếp
paragraphs.text: The event will take place at the local library on Saturday at two in the afternoon. During the session, participants will plan a study-friendly work schedule and practise customer conversations. There will also be time for questions and discussion, so everyone can share ideas and seek clarification.
